WITH site_averages AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces
  FROM sites AS s
  LEFT JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS avg_faces
  FROM site_averages
), status_averages AS (
  SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS avg_faces
  FROM site_averages
  WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY entrystat
), kept AS (
  SELECT sa.avg_faces, b.avg_faces AS baseline_faces, sta.avg_faces AS status_faces
  FROM site_averages AS sa
  JOIN baseline AS b ON b.avg_faces IS NOT NULL
  JOIN status_averages AS sta ON sta.entrystat = sa.entrystat
  WHERE sa.avg_faces > sta.avg_faces
)
SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS average_kept_site_faces,
       AVG(avg_faces - baseline_faces) AS average_excess_overall_baseline,
       AVG(avg_faces - status_faces) AS average_excess_over_status_average
FROM kept;
